messages:
Alex Kim: Quick sync — noticed duplicated SI leads in the pipeline this week. Need a short set of ground rules so partners don't both pursue same account.
Maya Patel: Yep saw that. Which accounts?
Alex Kim: Example: Acme Retail (ACME-123) got outreach from both CloudSI and Rescale. CRM shows both as open.
Grace Liu: we should enforce a 'claim window' + account mapping. Proposed: partner has 48h to claim after intake; if unclaimed, AE can assign.
Sanjay Rao: 48h seems short for large SI. Suggest 72h for enterprise > $200k.
Priya Nair: +1. Also add a mandatory 'lead intake form' link they must fill. That form includes OEM tag, solution area, engagement stage.
Alex Kim: Here's a quick mapping CSV we used last quarter:
```csv
account_id,territory,default_owner
ACME-123,NA-Enterprise,redwood-sales-na
GLOB-456,EMEA,partner-team-emea
```
Maya Patel: Can we add rule: marketplace-sourced leads auto-route to partner if listing selected? Otherwise route to AE.
Grace Liu: Yes. Also require 'co-sell intent' flag in SFDC -> triggers partner notification and reserves the lead for the partner.
crm-bot: [automation] Lead ACME-123 marked 'partner_reserved' for CloudSI. timestamp 1749009900
Sanjay Rao: Operational asks:
- templates for intro
- single shared playbook
- weekly queue review
Priya Nair: I'll draft email templates and a handoff checklist. Putting a stub in Confluence.
Grace Liu: Great. Also proposal: 'no double-touch' clause — partners must back off if another partner is actively pursuing within 14 days unless coordination occurs.
Maya Patel: Agree. Need an escalation path: @sanjay -> @grace -> Partnerships SM.
Alex Kim: Cool. Action items:
- Priya: templates + intake form link by EOD Tue
- Sanjay: update SFDC routing rules by Fri
- Grace: draft ROE doc, share for review
Maya Patel: I'll loop in legal for the partner CLA language.
Priya Nair: Form link: https://confluence.redwood/partner-intake (draft)
Sanjay Rao: SFDC rule PR opened: https://git.internal/sf/rules/381
Grace Liu: I'll post the ROE draft in #partnerships tomorrow.
Maya Patel: Thanks all :thumbsup:
Alex Kim: Thanks — schedule brief 15m next week to finalize.
